name: Below level 60 the client's classic dungeon list queues as Random Classic Dungeon
contract: Below level 60 the Ascension client does not send Random Classic Dungeon (258). It sends every classic dungeon
its own list shows, and that list keeps only dungeons whose recommended level is at most 15 under the player's
level. Players 20 or more levels apart then share nothing but Vaults of Inquisition (401) and Road to De Other
Side (402), the only classic dungeons with recommended level 59, so the queue matched them almost only into
those two. The server treats such a list as Random Classic Dungeon: each player's selection is 258 and the
server's level rules choose the dungeons. Solo players of levels 15, 35 and 55, each sending its own client
list, must be offered a proposal together and enter a classic dungeon. A level 60 player, whose client sends
258 itself, keeps a specific selection, and so does a single specific dungeon below level 60.
